mapper.select: SELECT r.batch_id FROM audit_archive_online_purge_receipt r JOIN audit_archive_batch b ON b.batch_id=r.batch_id WHERE r.recovery_version IS NULL AND b.state='ONLINE_PURGED' AND b.scope_type=#{scope.type} AND b.tenant_id=#{scope.tenant} ORDER BY r.applied_at,r.batch_id LIMIT 1
SELECT batch_id,recovery_version AS version,recovery_bytes AS byte_count,recovery_sha256 AS sha256 FROM audit_archive_online_purge_receipt WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND recovery_version IS NOT NULL
SELECT attempt_id FROM audit_archive_member WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY attempt_id
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_archive_batch SET state='ONLINE_PURGED',object_version=#{version},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND state IN ('CLAIMED','UPLOADED','VERIFIED')
